purpose: 조사 당시 임시 진단 소스의 기록. 제품 코드나 범용 도구가 아니며 지정한 Linux loopback 환경을 전제로 한다.
notes: 실행 스크립트의 임시 DB 접속 문자열만 RSS_DATABASE_URL 환경 변수 참조로 치환했다.
baseline-1 실행 때는 tcpdump 종료 전 1초 대기가 없었다. 이후 실행에는 종료 직전 캡처를 비우기 위한 1초 대기를 추가했다.
mutex mode 메타데이터는 실제 서버 진단 바이너리 해시를 기록한다. TCP 설정 비교는 같은 release 바이너리를 사용한다.
pcap parser는 캡처 전체의 SYN부터 연속된 TCP stream을 복원한다. 겹친 전송은 중복 바이트를 제외한다. gap_segments나 missing_syn이 있으면 분포를 완전한 결과로 해석하지 않는다.
원시 mutex 표본은 스레드 종료 시 출력되므로 파일 순서는 이벤트의 전역 시각 순서가 아니다.

sources.capture_run.py:
import subprocess,os,time,json,signal,sys,hashlib,pathlib
label=sys.argv[1]; mode=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'baseline'
root=pathlib.Path('/src/build/latency')/label;root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['RSS_DATABASE_URL']=os.environ['RSS_DATABASE_URL'];env['RSS_OBSERVABILITY_INTERVAL_SECONDS']='10'
server_cmd=['taskset','-c','0,1','/build/release/rss_server','127.0.0.1','19090','2']
client_cmd=['taskset','-c','2,3','/build/release/rss_load_scenario_runner','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','19090','--scenario','multi-room','--clients','20','--rooms','4','--messages','300','--payload-bytes','256','--repeat','3','--rate-per-client','10','--max-in-flight','8','--timeout-seconds','60']
trace_cmd=['taskset','-c','2,3','tcpdump','-B','8192','-i','lo','-nn','-s','0','-U','-w',str(root/'traffic.pcap'),'tcp port 19090']
with open(root/'tcpdump.stderr','w') as te,open(root/'server.ndjson','w') as so,open(root/'server.stderr','w') as se:
 t=subprocess.Popen(trace_cmd,stderr=te,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while 'listening on' not in (root/'tcpdump.stderr').read_text():
   if t.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('tcpdump startup')
   time.sleep(.02)
  if mode == 'server-nodelay':env['LD_PRELOAD']='/tmp/nodelay.so'
  if mode == 'mutex':server_cmd[3]='/build/mutex/rss_server'
  p=subprocess.Popen(server_cmd,env=env,stdout=so,stderr=se)
  try:
   deadline=time.monotonic()+10
   while 'server_started' not in (root/'server.ndjson').read_text():
    if p.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('server startup')
    time.sleep(.02)
   cenv=os.environ.copy()
   if mode == 'client-nodelay':cenv['LD_PRELOAD']='/tmp/nodelay.so'
   start=time.time_ns(); r=subprocess.run(client_cmd,env=cenv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=270);end=time.time_ns()
   (root/'client.stdout').write_text(r.stdout);(root/'client.stderr').write_text(r.stderr)
  finally:
   p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);p.wait(timeout=15)
 finally:
  time.sleep(1)
  t.send_signal(signal.SIGINT);t.wait(timeout=5)
meta={'label':label,'mode':mode,'server_command':server_cmd,'client_command':client_cmd,'capture_command':trace_cmd,'start_unix_ns':start,'end_unix_ns':end,'client_exit_code':r.returncode,'server_exit_code':p.returncode,'capture_exit_code':t.returncode,'sha256':{x:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(server_cmd[3] if x=='rss_server' else client_cmd[3]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in ['rss_server','rss_load_scenario_runner']}}
(root/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
print(label, 'server diagnostic bytes', (root/'server.stderr').stat().st_size, flush=True)
print((root/'server.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()[-2],flush=True)

import subprocess,os,time,json,signal,sys,hashlib,pathlib,resource
label=sys.argv[1];nodelay=len(sys.argv)>2
root=pathlib.Path('/src/build/latency')/label;root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['RSS_DATABASE_URL']=os.environ['RSS_DATABASE_URL'];env['RSS_OBSERVABILITY_INTERVAL_SECONDS']='10'
if nodelay:env['LD_PRELOAD']='/tmp/nodelay.so'
server_cmd=['taskset','-c','0,1','/build/release/rss_server','127.0.0.1','19090','2']
client_cmd=['taskset','-c','2,3','/build/release/rss_load_scenario_runner','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','19090','--scenario','multi-room','--clients','20','--rooms','4','--messages','300','--payload-bytes','256','--repeat','3','--rate-per-client','10','--max-in-flight','8','--timeout-seconds','60']
with open(root/'server.ndjson','w') as so,open(root/'server.stderr','w') as se:
 p=subprocess.Popen(server_cmd,env=env,stdout=so,stderr=se)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while 'server_started' not in (root/'server.ndjson').read_text():
   if p.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('server startup')
   time.sleep(.02)
  cpu_before=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat').read_text(); usage_before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
  start=time.time_ns();r=subprocess.run(client_cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=270);end=time.time_ns(); usage_after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN); cpu_after=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat').read_text(); server_stat=pathlib.Path('/proc',str(p.pid),'stat').read_text()
  (root/'client.stdout').write_text(r.stdout);(root/'client.stderr').write_text(r.stderr)
 finally:
  p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);p.wait(timeout=15)
meta={'label':label,'mode':'server-nodelay' if nodelay else 'baseline','capture':False,'cgroup_cpu_before':cpu_before,'cgroup_cpu_after':cpu_after,'client_cpu_seconds':usage_after.ru_utime+usage_after.ru_stime-usage_before.ru_utime-usage_before.ru_stime,'server_proc_stat':server_stat,'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'server_command':server_cmd,'client_command':client_cmd,'start_unix_ns':start,'end_unix_ns':end,'client_exit_code':r.returncode,'server_exit_code':p.returncode,'sha256':{x:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/build/release',x).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in ['rss_server','rss_load_scenario_runner']}}
(root/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n');print(label, r.returncode,flush=True)
